cut: v2 (owner, 24 Oct: 'It's good. His hands aren't on the phone and game visuals glitch'): the hands grip the phone, the game is a pure function of time, the offer off the bottom edge, the clock clear of the caption, the close-up brighter, captions at the big size. v1 (23 Oct): Toko set 1/4
argument: With an AI, a working game prototype takes an hour, but the AI always offers one more change, and that loop can eat the whole night; only the person can say enough.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn
